name: Octree Traversal for Surface Extraction
definition: Extracts a triangle mesh from the voxel octree by visiting leaf nodes. Occupied leaves are always converted to mesh. Empty leaves are converted only if their surface distance is negative, indicating they lie on the interior side of a surface boundary.
summary: Octree Traversal for Surface Extraction recursively traverses an octree to generate axis-aligned cube meshes directly from leaf nodes, differing from interpolation methods by producing blocky geometry.
